set.body: Outcome: deliver the AtlantaFX-derived Meridian native theme, optional workbench, ScalaDock adapter, sampler, and evidence-qualified application pilot. Canonical plan: PLAN.md. Acceptance: all phase gates and the provider receipt gate pass; light/dark and comfortable/compact are native-qualified; appearance preserves pane identities and scientific meaning; keyboard and overlay behavior meet explicit criteria; exact artifacts pass clean Java and Scala consumer tests. Implementation remains open. Public publication and unrelated runtime migrations require separate authorization.
set.title: MeridianFX v0.1: native design system with qualified ScalaDock integration
